1.3.1 — Live DPS denominator floor.

- Live DPS now divides by at least one second, so the first hit of a fight no longer reports an inflated value. The configured window still caps the denominator.

---
1.3.1 —— 实时 DPS 分母下限调整。

- 实时 DPS 的分母最少按 1 秒计算，战斗第一下不再出现虚高数值；上限仍由配置的窗口长度决定。
